messages:
Rina: Who's up for a mini LAN / couch co-op night next Thursday? Thinking Steam coop (Deep Rock Galactic?) + some console couch rounds.
Omar: I'm down. DRG sounds perfect. I can bring my PC and a crate of energy drinks. :muscle:
Priya: Count me in if there's Smash or Mario Kart on the side. Also I have an extra Switch Pro controller.
Jules: I can bring my PS5 if we want some Rocket League / couch FIFA warmups.
Rina: Nice mix. Quick poll: Steam coop main (DRG or L4D2) + console side for party games? React :thumbsup: for DRG, :heart: for L4D2, :eyes: for open vote.
Omar: :thumbsup: for DRG
Priya: :heart: for L4D2 but DRG works too
Jules: :eyes: open vote - flexible
Rina: Cool DRG lean then. Logistics: office TV available, bring HDMI + adapters. No alcohol per office policy.
Omar: I have a 10ft HDMI + Ethernet cable. Also will bring spare mouse and keyboard for anyone using PC.
Priya: I'll bring chairs and a power strip. Also vegan cookies for snacking.
Jules: Ill bring PS controller + stand and an extra HDMI.
deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window Thursday 18:30 - 19:00. Try to avoid noisy operations during that time.
Rina: Good catch. Let's start at 19:30 then and run till ~23:00.
calendar-bot: Event created: "LAN & Couch Games Night" Thursday 19:30 Office Common Room
